reviewFlags.detail: Google Earth imported the city overlay successfully; district overview and Gratiot detail were visually compared. Gratiot fallback decks now include both carriageways and their skew. Exact inferred deck widths, wall traces and measured per-building satellite residuals remain review items.

Southern trail and city terrain now use USGS 3DEP elevation evidence with Detroit/NAVD88 conversion. Historical source dates, raster interpolation, exact current bridge soffits and unmeasured wall heights remain limitations.

The Conservancy 2025 art-walk map confirms mural street segments and sides. It is schematic: exact panel coordinates, current artwork, wall condition and individual vegetation still need site-level verification.
